# Templates

Fill-in templates for the first weeks in a RevOps or GTM engineering role. They are company-neutral: `[COMPANY_NAME]` and `[CRM]` resolve when a company repo is scaffolded with `make new`.

| Template | Use it | When |
|---|---|---|
| [RevOps Operating Charter](RevOps_Operating_Charter.md) | Agree the mandate, decision rights, intake and how value is measured | Week 1, with your manager |
| [Definitions Pack](Definitions_Pack.md) | Pin down the 5-7 terms that cause the most confusion, including what each excludes | Weeks 1-2 |
| [RevOps Roadmap](RevOps_Roadmap.md) | Turn grand plans into ordered jobs, get sign-off, weave in ad hoc requests | Weeks 3-6 |
| [Build Spec](Build_Spec.md) | One page per build: problem, metric, controls, rollout, release note, value ledger | Every build |

Related: [first 90 days, Strategy & Ops](../../gtm_strategy_ops/first-90-days.md) · [first 90 days, GTM engineer](../../gtm_engineer/first-90-days.md) · [AI Workflow Standard](../../shared_core/ai_governance/README.md)
